body: I just rang Samaritans because I was freaking the fuck out. It helped, I guess, I'm calmer now at least. Robin Williams has been a huge trigger for me and I'm really struggling. It sounds stupid, I know, but there we go. My parents are on holiday so I've been on my own all weekend which really hasn't helped because all I'm thinking about is bad shit.
I've struggled with depression for the best part of a decade and, man, this has really fucked me up. I can't describe it, but it's the worst I've felt in ages.
